Municipality
              of
     Anchorage


     P.O Box 390                  GIRDWOOD VALLEY SERVICE AREA BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
      Girdwood, Alaska 99587                               Jennifer Wingard & Kellie Okonek, Co-Chairs
      http://www.muni.org/gbos                             Brian Burnett, Amanda Tuttle, Nick Crews
    Suzanne LaFrance, Mayor
                           August 31, 2026
          GBOS Special Meeting: 2027 GVSA Budget Approval
                              Minutes Final
        10 a.m. via Microsoft Teams & Girdwood Community Room

This hybrid meeting is taking place via Microsoft Teams & at the Girdwood Community Room, 250 Egloff Rd:

The Girdwood Board of Supervisors is subject to the Alaska Open Meetings Act as found in Alaska Statute 44.62.310
and Anchorage Municipal Code1.25 - Public Meetings.
The Girdwood Board of Supervisors operates under the Girdwood Public Meetings Standards of Conduct.

Call to Order 10:08 a.m. Jennifer Wingard, Co-Chair
Land Acknowledgement: The Girdwood Board of Supervisors acknowledges the indigenous peoples of Alaska, whose land we
reside on. The community of Girdwood, situated between the areas known to be Dena'ina and Alutiiq homeland, respects the people
who were stewards of this land for generations. We commit to the continued stewardship of this land and are grateful to be part of a
wider community that seeks to maintain a sustainable use of Girdwood Valley for present and future peoples.

Roll Call
Jennifer Wingard (JW), Brian Burnett (BB), Kellie Okonek (KO)
Amanda Tuttle (AT) joined at 11AM; Nick Crews (NC) joined 11:10AM
Disclosures: none

Agenda Revisions and Approval:   Aug 31 GBOS Special Meeting Agenda Approved      KO/BB Assent
Agenda:
1.     Review of GVSA and Municipal budgets
2.     Review and approval of 2027 proposed budgets
        a. Fire Department Budget
Motion:
GBOS moves to approve the 2027 Girdwood Fire Dept budget of $1,782,143, not including IGCs.
Motion by KO, 2nd BB
Motion carries 3-0 in roll call vote

GBOS adds to Sept 21 regular meeting Old Business Resolution of Support for increase in EMS budget from
Municipality of Anchorage Areawide funds. Nick Crews will be tasked with drafting resolution for that meeting.

GBOS adds to October MOA GBOS meeting discussion of EMS funding in GVSA and for EMS Service area.

        b. Housing and Economic Stability Budget
Motion:
GBOS moves to approve the 2027 Girdwood Housing and Economic budget of $100,000.
Motion by KO, 2nd BB
Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

           GBOS Meeting Agendas and minutes are available on line: http://www.muni.org/gbos

                                                                                         1

It is noted that the 2026 budget has not yet been expended. RFP for Housing study has been delayed. Fundings will
be moved to a capital account so that they remain available for this project.

         c. Roads Budget
Motion:
GBOS moves to approve the 2027 Roads and Drainage budget of $1,892,509, not including IGCs.
Motion by KO/BB
Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote

It is noted that executive staff member COLA increase is at the discretion of the Mayor; GBOS will watch to see if
increases are made in 2027 and may add increase to the 2028 budget.

        d. Parks and Recreation Budget
Motion:
GBOS moves to approve the 2027 Parks and Recreation budget of $760,368, not including IGCs.
Motion by KO/NC
Return to original motion:
Motion passes 5-0 in roll call vote

Amendments considered but not passed:
Motion:
Amend to increase GVT hard funding to $10,000.
Motion by AT/BB
Motion fails 1-4 in roll call vote

Motion:
Amend to increase Contracted Service to others (AK Trails) to $15,000.
Motion by BB/KO
Motion fails 1-4 in roll call vote

It is noted that in future budgets GBOS may want to include change in funding of non-profit recreation grants as they
have been static for some time.

        e. Police Budget
Motion:
GBOS moves to approve the 2027 Police budget of $924,625, including IGCs.
Motion by KO/BB
Motion carries 5-0 in roll call vote.

3.     Review and approval of MOA Budget request for Public Safety IT items
No recommendation brought forward through WPD.

4.      Progress of TIPS proposed items at MOA after GBOS regular meeting Aug 17.
TIPS proposed items were forwarded to the Municipal Manager and receipt was confirmed.

Public Comment:    None
Adjourn      11:50AM
